response.sql:
WITH customer_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        c.state_county_province,
        ft.transaction_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
    JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
), state_totals AS (
    SELECT
        state_county_province,
        SUM(transaction_amount) AS state_total
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
    SELECT
        state_total,
        state_total / NULLIF(SUM(state_total) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM state_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT
        state_total,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM state_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(state_total) AS combined_transaction_total,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: Each transaction belongs to the customer associated with its account; transactions without a matching account and customer are dropped. States are grouped by the stored state/province value, with NULL forming its own group.
